Parameters

ParameterDefaultAllowed valuesStatusDescription
axisNonex | yrequiredAxis the value is on: y draws a horizontal line. A GraphSpec must set it.
valueNonefloat | date | columnrequiredThe line's value, or a column to aggregate. On a datetime axis, a date, e.g. 2025-08-25. A GraphSpec must set it.
aggregation
functionNonemean | median | sum | min | max | stddev | NonevariableThe aggregate. None: value is a number.
multiplier1floatvariableWhat the aggregate is multiplied by, e.g. 2 for twice the stddev.
per_seriesfalsetrue | falsevariableWith a column: one line per named series, its replicates together, in its color.
label
textNonetext | aggregation | value | aggregation_value | Nonevariableaggregation: e.g. Mean. value: e.g. 14.9. aggregation_value: Mean: 14.9. None: no label. Other text: written as given.
positionautoauto | start_above | start_below | center_above | center_below | end_above | end_belowvariableauto: the first clear one.
formatautotext | autovariableNumber format of the value, e.g. ".2f"; on a date axis, a date format, e.g. "%b %-d". auto: one decimal more than the axis's tick labels; on a date axis, its tick label format.
